input.oldString:
show_usage() {
    print_success "Installation completed!"
    echo
    print_status "Usage examples:"
    echo "  propscan                    # Scan all package managers"
    echo "  propscan -m flatpak         # Scan only Flatpak"
    echo "  propscan -f json            # Output as JSON"
    echo "  propscan --list-managers    # List available package managers"
    echo "  propscan --help             # Show help"
    echo
    print_status "You may need to restart your terminal or run:"
    echo "  source ~/.bashrc"
    echo
}
input.newString:
show_usage() {
    print_success "Installation completed!"
    echo
    print_status "PropScan has been installed in a virtual environment at:"
    echo "  $VENV_DIR"
    echo
    print_status "A wrapper script has been created at:"
    echo "  $HOME/.local/bin/propscan"
    echo
    print_status "Make sure $HOME/.local/bin is in your PATH. Add this to your ~/.bashrc if needed:"
    echo "  export PATH=\"\$HOME/.local/bin:\$PATH\""
    echo
    print_status "Usage examples:"
    echo "  propscan                    # Scan all package managers"
    echo "  propscan -m flatpak         # Scan only Flatpak"
    echo "  propscan -f json            # Output as JSON"
    echo "  propscan --list-managers    # List available package managers"
    echo "  propscan --help             # Show help"
    echo
    print_status "You may need to restart your terminal or run:"
    echo "  source ~/.bashrc"
    echo
}
